narr: On the morning of July 21st, a cluster of showers and thunderstorms containing heavy rainfall developed over the Twin Cities metropolitan area along a slow-moving surface frontal boundary. Rainfall rates neared two inches per hour which caused urban flash flooding in downtown St. Paul at the intersection of I-35E and Shepard Rd. A car was left stranded with all lanes of traffic underwater.
ev: A MNDOT traffic camera showed the intersection of I-35E and Shepard Rd flooded, with one car stranded in the flood water due to heavy rainfall. Other cars were using the freeway entrance ramp to get around the flooded roadway since the regular traffic lanes were all under water.
